title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: hashtabdelet
text:
hash table delete
hash table delete
(algorithm)
Definition:
If the
hash table
uses
chaining
, use the chaining data structure delete.  If it uses
open addressing
, mark the item "deleted" for future reuse.
See also
cuckoo hashing
.
